setup: The angle in question measures [[given]] degrees.

steps.say: A straight angle is 180 degrees — a full turn of the arm from one ray to the opposite one — so the remainder is 180 − [[given]] = [[missing]].
Angles are named by their size: acute is under 90, right is exactly 90, obtuse is over 90 but under 180, and straight is 180. [[given]] degrees is therefore a [[cls]].
